breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses dx=1/Nx with Nx=1024 points on [0,1) and x_j = j*dx for j=0,...,Nx-1, matching the ground truth's periodic grid convention. The contradictory preamble instruction about interpreting Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints with dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1) was not carried forward.
